text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the tryouts,
but before the
races begin, I go to see how
Kawakami
Princess is doing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer. You really came to see my
race.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get much sleep to be honest!
I was so nervous I couldn't think
straight, so I
watched all forty-nine episodes of
Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I don't know! But even Princess Fighter
says princesses have to risk it
all at the
end, so I have to try!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Okay, I should get going!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The weather's finally cleared after last
night's rain, but which Umamusume will be
a breath of fresh air and claim their
chance to
debut?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
All these evenly matched Umamusume will
make for a highly competitive race.
Everyone's lined up at the gates, and...
there's the
start!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, it feels great to run with
everything I
have!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I've always loved princesses, but I love
being active too.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Then when I met King, I was really
impressed. Sure, she has the
dignity of a
princess,
but... she also never loses spirit.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Her and Princess Fighter have that same
dazzling strength. It makes
me jealous of
how bright and sparkly they are...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (But what is it I really admire most?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (It's so hard... I just don't know. I tried copying them, but that didn't help. What do I want to be? What kind of princess do I want to become?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer said I have my own way, that I
have my own ideal to aim for...
But I don't
see it!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, she slipped right before the last
turn! Kawakami Princess is
hurtling toward
the outside.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That sent her into the mud. She must've
misjudged the track... Ah
well, these things
happen with pre-debuts.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It'll be hard to get back after that.
Kinda
makes me feel bad for her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I don't understand... Can I really not do
this?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Am I not meant to become... a princess?)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's regained control! Kawakami Princess
is running with all her
might now. Will she
be able to catch up to the front though?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will she make it? She can't close the gap,
but she's trying hard.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I hear you... loud... and CLEAR!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This is amazing! Kawakami Princess is
giving an amazing chase. She's
going
straight to the front from way outside!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! I... am... a princess! I will become a princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I see it now. All I really wanted was to
never give up... on becoming a
princess
and on being myself!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (The whole point of an ideal is to help me be a better me. It's all for nothing if I don't keep running for my dream and for myself!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hraaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: That's the finish!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess was on fire! She fought
till the last and made it all
the way to first
place!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Look at me now! A princess smashes
through any adversity!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Traineeer,
I did it! I went for what I wanted
and took the win!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for cheering for me! I
could hear you so clearly,
and I'll never
forget it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I really do want to be a beautiful,
graceful, and courageous
princess. But a
princess...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Keeps on running through the worst of it
and never gives up on
herself! A princess
never gives up on her ideals!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So I don't care if I looked a little
ungraceful this time! I'm going to
become
graceful someday, in my own special way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her beaming expression, I realize
that I have to tell her right
now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wha? You want to help? Wait, does that
mean what I think it means?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So long as she wants to become her ideal
version of a princess, I want
to become a
legendary trainer to help her along the
way.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You opened my eyes when I'd
lost sight of my dream!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I know I can be my ideal version of a
princess with your help! I won't
fail!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Our legend will rock the world! Onward to
beauty, grace, and
becoming the
strongest, fastest princess there is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the day I start my adventure with
the rough and tough
Kawakami Princess!
